verses.micro: God's word gives me strength
verses.insight: God's word imparts the strength it commands.
verses.prayer: Lord, speak peace and strength to my heart.

verses.text: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
verses.micro: I go and meet Jesus.
verses.insight: Following His command leads me to encounter Him.
verses.prayer: Jesus, help me go and find You.

verses.text: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
verses.micro: God is my light in darkness
verses.insight: When I'm surrounded by darkness, I still trust God to be my light.
verses.prayer: Lord, be my light when I feel lost.

verses.text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
verses.micro: My strength comes from my hope in God.
verses.insight: Hoping in God gives me the courage I need.
verses.prayer: Lord, strengthen my heart as I hope in You.

verses.text: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
verses.micro: My hope is a steady posture.
verses.insight: Hoping in God is a continuous choice, not a one-time feeling.
verses.prayer: Anchor my hope in You, Lord, day by day.

verses.text: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

verses.prayer: Let your Word fill me with hope.

verses.prayer: Lord, anchor my hope in You.

verses.insight: In God, I find a rest that no fear can touch.
verses.prayer: Lord, grant me Your fearless peace.

verses.insight: Even when life is hard, I can find peace in Christ.
verses.prayer: Lord, let me rest in Your peace when trouble comes.

verses.text: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
verses.micro: I am filled with the gospel's blessing.
verses.insight: I am fully blessed by the gospel, and that blessing overflows through me.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my life carry the fullness of Your gospel.

title: Repentance
subtitle: When you want to turn back

verses.text: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
verses.micro: My sins leave me feeling hopeless
verses.insight: God offers hope to those crushed by sin.
verses.prayer: Lord, remind me that repentance leads to life.

verses.text: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
verses.micro: I act in ignorance, but God guides.
verses.insight: Even in my ignorance, God's love remains.
verses.prayer: Lord, open my eyes when I act in ignorance.

verses.text: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

verses.insight: Because God forgives me, others show me compassion.
verses.prayer: Lord, grant me compassion in the eyes of those around me.

verses.text: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.micro: My sin feels heavy and foolish
verses.insight: I realize my sin is not just wrong but also foolish.
verses.prayer: Lord, forgive my guilt and folly.

verses.text: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
verses.micro: God sees my hidden motives.
verses.insight: Unrepentant hearts face God's exposure and judgment.
verses.prayer: Lord, examine my heart and forgive my hidden sins.

verses.text: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
verses.micro: I see my sin against God.
verses.insight: I realize my sin is against God, not just others.
verses.prayer: Father, give me courage to return and confess.

verses.text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.micro: I am cleansed when I confess my sin
verses.insight: I learn that confessing my sin specifically brings me forgiveness, not condemnation.
verses.prayer: Lord, I confess my sin and trust Your forgiveness.

verses.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.micro: My deliverance starts with my confession
verses.insight: When I confess my sin, I find deliverance from my own foolishness.
verses.prayer: Lord, deliver me from my sins.

verses.text: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.micro: God alone cleans my heart
verses.insight: Only God can reach the hidden stains within me that I cannot clean myself.
verses.prayer: Wash me throughly, Lord, and make me clean.

title: Resolve
subtitle: When you have decided and need to hold on

verses.text: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.micro: I know Jesus, so I trust Him.
verses.insight: My confidence comes from knowing Jesus personally, not just knowing about Him.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I trust You because I know You.

verses.text: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verses.micro: My faith puts out every lie.
verses.insight: Faith helps me see through the lies that try to scare me.
verses.prayer: Lord, strengthen my faith to shield me from fear.

verses.text: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verses.micro: God is my helper, I am safe
verses.insight: Because God helps me, I don't need to fear what others do.
verses.prayer: Lord, You are my helper, I trust You.

verses.text: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.micro: My fear rests in God's eternal care.
verses.insight: I put my fear in God, not in those who can only hurt my body.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me fear only You, who holds my soul.

verses.text: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.micro: I rest in the Spirit's guidance.
verses.insight: Relying on self-preparation invites failure; trust the Spirit instead.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me trust Your Spirit more than my own planning.

verses.text: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.micro: His presence defines my reality
verses.insight: When I focus on God's presence, my fear fades.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me declare I will not fear, trusting You are my shield.

verses.text: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
verses.micro: Christ's truth anchors my actions
verses.insight: When Christ's truth is my foundation, my actions become steady and sure.
verses.prayer: Lord, anchor my choices in Your reality.

verses.text: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
verses.micro: Christ's work gives me authority.
verses.insight: I don't need to prove myself; Christ's work in me is my authority.
verses.prayer: Lord, let Your work in me be my proof.

verses.text: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
verses.micro: I am surrounded by more than I see.
verses.insight: I am not alone; there is more with me than meets the eye.
verses.prayer: Lord, open my eyes to see Your protection and trust it.

verses.text: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
verses.micro: Knowing God deeply is my strength.
verses.insight: Those who know God will stand firm and do great exploits.
verses.prayer: Lord, ground my strength in knowing You.

title: Sadness
subtitle: When you are low

verses.text: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
verses.micro: God's word gives me strength
verses.insight: God's word imparts the strength it commands.
verses.prayer: Lord, speak peace and strength to my heart.

verses.text: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
verses.micro: God comforts me in my sorrow
verses.insight: God commands comfort for His people after judgment ends.
verses.prayer: Comfort me, Lord, in my sorrow.

verses.text: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.micro: My sorrow ends in God's joy.
verses.insight: My sorrow is temporary, and God's joy is on the way.
verses.prayer: Lord, anchor my heart in the joy You promise.

verses.text: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
verses.micro: I am comforted even in suffering.
verses.insight: When I suffer, I know God's comfort is near.
verses.prayer: Lord, make my hope steady in suffering.

verses.text: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
verses.micro: I work with hope for God's provision.
verses.insight: I work with hope, trusting that God will provide for my needs.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my work be filled with hopeful expectation.

verses.text: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
verses.micro: I stir myself by remembering truth.
verses.insight: I stir my heart when I remember the truths I believe.
verses.prayer: Lord, stir my heart to hold fast to Your truth.

verses.text: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
verses.micro: Christ stands by me in darkness
verses.insight: Christ's presence assures believers of His purpose in every trial.
verses.prayer: Lord, be near me when I am afraid.

verses.text: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.
verses.micro: God is my safety
verses.insight: Even when everything falls apart, I find my security in God, not in my own plans.
verses.prayer: Lord, anchor me in Your promise.

verses.text: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.
verses.micro: I need physical strength to endure.
verses.insight: God's deliverance does not remove the need for daily care.
verses.prayer: Help me take the nourishment I need today.

verses.text: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
verses.micro: Each day God renews my strength.
verses.insight: God promises strength perfectly matched to each day's demands.
verses.prayer: Give me strength for each new day.

title: Seeking in confusion
subtitle: When you are lost and looking

verses.text: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
verses.micro: I seek wisdom like hidden treasure.
verses.insight: When I pursue wisdom with passion, I see what my heart truly wants.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me a passionate search for Your wisdom.

verses.text: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
verses.micro: I find understanding by seeking God
verses.insight: The more I seek God, the more I understand His ways.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me seek You for understanding.

verses.text: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.micro: God alone knows wisdom's dwelling
verses.insight: I cannot find wisdom on my own; only God knows where it is.
verses.prayer: Lord, teach me to seek wisdom in reverence of You.

verses.text: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.micro: I cry out for understanding
verses.insight: I seek understanding with urgency, knowing I need it to live.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me a heart that cries for wisdom.

verses.text: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.micro: I admit I do not know.
verses.insight: Admitting my ignorance opens me to truth and God's instruction.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me humility to say 'I do not know.'

verses.text: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
verses.micro: I receive God's word for me.
verses.insight: I receive His word as spoken directly to me.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me receive Your word as spoken to me.

verses.text: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.micro: I find God when I seek Him.
verses.insight: My earnest seeking leads me to truly know God.
verses.prayer: Lord, reward my seeking with knowing You deeply.

verses.text: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.micro: I humbly seek what God hides.
verses.insight: I see that searching for hidden truths is a way to honor God.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me seek the wisdom You conceal.

title: Seeking truth
subtitle: When you want to know what is real

verses.text: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.micro: My heart is not a safe guide
verses.insight: I often think I know what's best, but my own understanding can lead me astray.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me to trust Your wisdom over my own.

verses.text: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
verses.micro: Misplaced trust leaves me helpless.
verses.insight: I feel helpless when I trust in the wrong things.
verses.prayer: Lord, guard my trust from unfaithful places.

verses.text: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
verses.micro: I let truth confront my errors.
verses.insight: I recognize that truth can feel like an enemy when it exposes my errors.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me courage to speak and receive truth.

verses.text: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
verses.micro: My freedom builds others in love.
verses.insight: My freedom is meant to build others up.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my freedom edify your people.

verses.text: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
verses.micro: I keep innocence while growing understanding.
verses.insight: I try to stay innocent of wrong while becoming mature in my thinking.
verses.prayer: Lord, keep my heart pure and my mind growing in understanding.

verses.text: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:
verses.micro: I seek wisdom that lasts.
verses.insight: I want wisdom that remains when everything else fades.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me wisdom that endures.

verses.text: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.
verses.micro: God does not judge me by what I eat.
verses.insight: My relationship with God is unchanged by food.
verses.prayer: Keep me from making food a spiritual issue.

verses.text: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.micro: I cannot hide from the truth.
verses.insight: God's truth will find those who try to hide from it.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me courage to face Your truth.

verses.text: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
verses.micro: I ask God for a listening heart.
verses.insight: I want a heart that hears and discerns what is good.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me a listening heart to discern good and bad.

title: Service
subtitle: When you are caring for others

verses.text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.micro: I carry burdens with Christ's love.
verses.insight: When I help carry someone's weight, I am living out Christ's own law.
verses.prayer: Lord, show me the burdens I can help carry.

verses.text: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verses.micro: My first responsibility is to my brothers and sist...
verses.insight: Neglecting fellow believers forfeits your opportunity to do good.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me cherish and serve my brothers.

verses.text: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
verses.micro: I see God's design in togetherness.
verses.insight: Even human cooperation points to God's design for true community.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me see Your design in my community.

verses.text: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.
verses.micro: I seek the good of others.
verses.insight: I find joy in seeking the good of others.
verses.prayer: Lord, turn my heart toward others' good.

verses.text: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
verses.micro: My wealth is in what I give
verses.insight: I am truly rich when I use what I have to bless others.
verses.prayer: Make me generous, ready to share Your love.

verses.text: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
verses.micro: I love even when love is not returned
verses.insight: I am willing to be spent for others, even if they don't love me back.
verses.prayer: Lord, fill me with love that gives freely.

verses.text: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
verses.micro: I find blessing in giving, not getting.
verses.insight: I realize that true blessing comes from giving, not getting.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me find blessing in giving, not getting.

verses.text: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.micro: I am free to love, not to indulge
verses.insight: My freedom is not for selfish indulgence but for loving others.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me use my freedom to love and serve others.

verses.text: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
verses.micro: I give from my living
verses.insight: I understand that true giving requires me to trust God with my security.
verses.prayer: Lord, teach me to trust You when I give my security.

verses.text: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

title: Stress
subtitle: When you are under strain

verses.text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.micro: I sleep in God's peace
verses.insight: I can rest because God keeps me safe, not because everything is calm.
verses.prayer: Let me lay down my burdens and trust Your care.

verses.text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
verses.micro: God watches over me while I sleep
verses.insight: I can sleep peacefully knowing God is watching over me.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me confidence that You watch over my rest.

verses.text: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.micro: I sleep well trusting God
verses.insight: Trusting God's wisdom settles my soul.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me sweet sleep from trusting Your care.

verses.text: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.micro: I trust God, my fear fades.
verses.insight: When I trust God, my fear of others quiets.
verses.prayer: Lord, I trust You to calm my fear.

verses.text: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.micro: God's watchfulness calms my fears.
verses.insight: Night terrors lose their power when I trust His constant care.
verses.prayer: Lord, calm my fears with your constant watchfulness.

verses.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
verses.micro: My trust goes deeper than bad news
verses.insight: Even when the news is hard, I find a place of peace inside.
verses.prayer: Lord, steady my heart when fear tries to take over.

verses.text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.micro: My soul rests in God's goodness
verses.insight: I find rest not in circumstances, but in remembering how good God has been.
verses.prayer: Lord, help my soul find rest in Your goodness.

verses.text: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
verses.micro: My security is in God's mercy.
verses.insight: I find my security not in what I hold but in God's unfailing mercy.
verses.prayer: Lord, plant me in Your mercy, my true security.

verses.text: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.micro: I trust God, so fear fades.
verses.insight: Trusting God shrinks human threats to their proper size.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my trust in You silence my fears.

title: Temptation
subtitle: When you are being pulled away

verses.text: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
verses.micro: My choices show I am God's child.
verses.insight: I see that my choices reveal whether I am truly living as God's child.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my actions prove I am Your child.

verses.text: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.micro: I live right because I am His.
verses.insight: When I act rightly, I see myself in Christ.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my life reflect Your righteousness.

verses.text: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.micro: I find more profit in godliness.
verses.insight: Godliness brings lasting benefit beyond physical training.
verses.prayer: Lord, let me seek what lasts—godliness.

verses.text: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
verses.micro: Knowing God wakes me to live right
verses.insight: Knowing God awakens a desire in me to live rightly.
verses.prayer: Lord, wake me from slumber and lead me to live right.

verses.text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.micro: My great gain is in God
verses.insight: When I focus on godliness and contentment, I find real wealth.
verses.prayer: Help me find my gain in You, Lord.

verses.text: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.
verses.micro: I repent by acting justly.
verses.insight: My repentance feels real when I treat others with fairness and kindness.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me act justly as I repent.

verses.text: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
verses.micro: My worship flows from a true heart
verses.insight: God desires worship that springs from a truthful heart.
verses.prayer: Lord, make my worship honest and true.

verses.text: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
verses.micro: God sees my hidden good.
verses.insight: Even when no one notices, God sees the good I quietly do.
verses.prayer: Help me serve faithfully, knowing You see everything.

verses.text: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
verses.micro: Love trains my judgment daily.
verses.insight: When I let love guide my choices, I learn to discern what is excellent.
verses.prayer: Lord, fill my love with knowledge to approve what is excellent.

verses.text: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
verses.micro: I bear fruit of repentance.
verses.insight: Without visible fruit, repentance remains unproven.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my life reflect my change of heart.

title: Thanksgiving
subtitle: When you are grateful

verses.text: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
verses.micro: My gifts come from His grace
verses.insight: Every good thing in my life is a gift from Christ's grace.
verses.prayer: Thank You for the grace that gives me every good thing.

verses.text: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
verses.micro: God grows my faithfulness as I serve.
verses.insight: As I serve God, He strengthens my trust in Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, increase my faithfulness as I serve You.

verses.text: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
verses.micro: I long to respond to His goodness.
verses.insight: God's goodness stirs a longing in me to respond.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me respond to Your goodness.

verses.text: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
verses.micro: I give because God gave first.
verses.insight: The gift of Jesus is so overwhelming that I want to give generously.
verses.prayer: Thank You for Your indescribable gift.

verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.micro: God's holiness changes worry to worship
verses.insight: I notice that contemplating God's holiness turns my worry into worship.
verses.prayer: Lord, transform my worry into worship through Your holiness.

verses.text: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
verses.micro: My giving leads others to thank God.
verses.insight: I see how my generosity becomes a reason for others to praise God.
verses.prayer: Lord, use my giving to draw thanks to you.

verses.text: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.micro: My gratitude becomes my offering.
verses.insight: My thankfulness spills into my actions and speech.
verses.prayer: Lord, turn my private relief into public praise.

verses.text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.micro: I bring my heart, not perfection.
verses.insight: I approach God with a grateful heart, not perfection.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me come with a thankful heart.

verses.text: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.micro: My praise grows from His goodness.
verses.insight: When I remember God's goodness, my heart lifts in praise.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me remember Your goodness and sing again.

title: Trust
subtitle: When you are not sure what comes next

verses.text: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
verses.micro: My hope is in God, not in optimism.
verses.insight: I find that my hope is safest when it rests in God, not in circumstances.
verses.prayer: Lord, teach me to trust in You alone.

verses.text: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.micro: My stability is in God.
verses.insight: I find my stability in God's unchanging character.
verses.prayer: Lord, anchor my heart in Your steadfast love.

verses.text: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.
verses.micro: My trust in God saves me.
verses.insight: God delivers those who trust in Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me trust You to save me.

verses.text: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.micro: My confidence is in God's care
verses.insight: I place my confidence in God's care, not my own plans.
verses.prayer: Lord, be my confidence and keep my foot from stumbling.

verses.text: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.micro: My faith plants seeds for the future.
verses.insight: I can trust God's promises beyond my own life, planting seeds for generations to come.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me leave a legacy of faith.

verses.text: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.micro: My home is in God's promise
verses.insight: Faith finds its home in God's promise, not in a place.
verses.prayer: Help me live lightly here, anchored in Your promise.

verses.text: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
verses.micro: I am a child given to Christ
verses.insight: Because I am one of the children God gave to Jesus, I can trust Him fully.
verses.prayer: Jesus, help me trust the Father as You did.

verses.text: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.micro: I thrive when rooted in God.
verses.insight: When my roots are in God, I can survive any dry season.
verses.prayer: Lord, keep me rooted in You.

verses.text: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
verses.micro: I trust God more than leaders.
verses.insight: God's faithfulness surpasses any human leader's reliability.
verses.prayer: Lord, remind me that you are my true refuge.

verses.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
verses.micro: Seeking God meets all my needs.
verses.insight: I discover that seeking God fulfills my deepest needs.
verses.prayer: Lord, let me find my true good in You alone.

title: Uncertainty
subtitle: When the way is not clear

verses.text: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.micro: My heart is not a safe guide
verses.insight: I often think I know what's best, but my own understanding can lead me astray.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me to trust Your wisdom over my own.

verses.text: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
verses.micro: Misplaced trust leaves me helpless.
verses.insight: I feel helpless when I trust in the wrong things.
verses.prayer: Lord, guard my trust from unfaithful places.

verses.text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verses.micro: I trust God for today.
verses.insight: I don't need to carry tomorrow's worries because I trust God for today.
verses.prayer: Help me trust You for today, not tomorrow.

verses.text: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
verses.micro: My happiness is in trusting God
verses.insight: When I trust God instead of my own plans, I find true happiness.
verses.prayer: Lord, anchor my heart in trusting you alone.

verses.text: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
verses.micro: I am safe in God's trust.
verses.insight: I see that fearing people traps me, but trusting God sets me safe.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me trust You, not people.

verses.text: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
verses.micro: I trust God with unseen kindness.
verses.insight: I can give generously without knowing the return, trusting God's timing.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me trust You with my kindness.

verses.text: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.micro: I sleep well trusting God
verses.insight: Trusting God's wisdom settles my soul.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me sweet sleep from trusting Your care.

verses.text: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
verses.micro: I act without waiting for certainty.
verses.insight: I don't need to have all the answers before I step out in faith.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me courage to act without seeing the outcome.

verses.text: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.
verses.micro: I trust God with my sowing
verses.insight: I trust God with my work, not knowing which will prosper.
verses.prayer: Lord, I trust you with what I sow.

verses.text: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
verses.micro: My own strength cannot bear eternity.
verses.insight: I realize my own strength cannot sustain me forever.
verses.prayer: Lord, keep me from leaning on my own strength.

title: Unity
subtitle: When people are divided

verses.text: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
verses.micro: My patience builds unity with others
verses.insight: When I am patient with others, I see unity grow among us.
verses.prayer: Lord, teach me to wait for others with patience.

verses.text: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.micro: My kin are those who follow God.
verses.insight: I find my true family among those who share God's path with me.
verses.prayer: Lord Jesus, help me see my family in those who follow You.

verses.text: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.micro: I belong with those who follow God.
verses.insight: I realize my true community is with everyone who seeks to obey God.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me embrace your spiritual family.

verses.text: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
verses.micro: My faith comes alive in love
verses.insight: When I show simple love to others, my faith feels real.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my love make my faith visible.

verses.text: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.micro: I belong to a worldwide family.
verses.insight: Even far away, I am connected to God's people everywhere.
verses.prayer: Unite us as one family, Lord.

verses.text: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
verses.micro: My treatment of others honors Christ
verses.insight: When I honor others in peace, I reflect my love for Christ.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me to treat Your servants with peace.

verses.text: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
verses.micro: I belong in God's family
verses.insight: I'm realizing that I'm not an outsider anymore; I'm part of God's own household.
verses.prayer: Help me live as a true member of your family.

verses.text: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
verses.micro: Divisions in worship wound my soul.
verses.insight: When I see division among us, it deeply hurts me.
verses.prayer: Lord, heal our divisions and unite us in worship.

title: Worship
subtitle: When you want to praise God

verses.text: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.micro: My praise grows from His goodness.
verses.insight: When I remember God's goodness, my heart lifts in praise.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me remember Your goodness and sing again.

verses.text: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.micro: My life is a song of praise.
verses.insight: I feel my life becoming a song of praise to God.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my life be a song of praise.

verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.micro: God's holiness changes worry to worship
verses.insight: I notice that contemplating God's holiness turns my worry into worship.
verses.prayer: Lord, transform my worry into worship through Your holiness.

verses.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
verses.micro: My laughter declares God's greatness.
verses.insight: My joy becomes a sign of what God has done.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my joy point others to You.

verses.text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.micro: God turns my mourning to joy.
verses.insight: I experience God turning my mourning into joy.
verses.prayer: Lord, turn my mourning into dancing.

verses.text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.micro: My gladness rests on God's actions.
verses.insight: I am glad because of what God has done, not how I feel.
verses.prayer: Lord, root my joy in Your faithful work.

verses.text: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.micro: My life springs from God
verses.insight: Everything good in me flows from God.
verses.prayer: Lord, You are the spring of my life.

verses.text: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.micro: God turns my emptiness into joy.
verses.insight: God takes what feels empty in me and makes it a place of joy.
verses.prayer: Lord, fill my barren places with joyful life.

verses.text: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.micro: My joy comes from God's salvation.
verses.insight: My joy is anchored in God's salvation, not my circumstances.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my joy rest in Your salvation.
